description: The plot illustrates the relationship between temperature and accuracy for three different methods, comparing their performance across a range of temperatures. The x-axis represents temperature, with a linear scale, ranging from 0.1 to 1.0, and tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The y-axis represents accuracy, measured as Pass@8, with a linear scale, ranging from 62.5 to 80.0, and tick labels at intervals of 2.5. The plot displays three lines: the orange line with triangle markers and a solid style represents On-policy RL, starting at around 63.0 at a temperature of 0.1, fluctuating to a peak of approximately 75.0 at a temperature of 0.6, and ending at around 70.0 at a temperature of 1.0; the red line with star markers and a solid style represents an unspecified method, starting at around 74.0 at a temperature of 0.1, generally increasing to a peak of approximately 80.5 at a temperature of 1.0, with some fluctuations; the blue line with circle markers and a solid style represents SFT, starting at around 75.0 at a temperature of 0.1, decreasing to around 72.5 at a temperature of 0.5, and then increasing to approximately 74.0 at a temperature of 1.0.
